skull.definition: The bony skeleton of the head of vertebrates.

cranium.definition: The part of the skull that encloses the brain.

jaw-bone.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «جاو بوني»
jaw-bone.definition: The bone that forms the lower or upper part of the mouth.

cheekbone.definition: The arch of bone beneath the eye that forms the prominence of the cheek.

eye-socket.definition: The bony hollow in the skull that holds an eye.

nasal-bone.definition: This elongated, rectangular bone provides the nose’s bony bridge.

temple-bone.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «تيمبلي بوني»
temple-bone.definition: A bone at the side and base of the skull near the ear.

foramen-magnum.definition: A large opening in the skull’s base allows the spinal cord to continue into the brain.
foramen-magnum.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «فورامين ماجنوم»

mandible.definition: The jaw in vertebrates that is hinged to open the mouth.

maxilla.definition: The jaw in vertebrates that is fused to the cranium.

spine.definition: The series of vertebrae forming the axis of the skeleton and protecting the spinal cord.

vertebra.definition: One of the bony segments of the spinal column.

cervical-spine.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «كيرفيكال سبيني»
cervical-spine.definition: The part of the backbone located in the neck.

thoracic-spine.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «ثوراكيك سبيني»
thoracic-spine.definition: The part of the backbone located behind the chest.

lumbar-spine.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «لومبار سبيني»
lumbar-spine.definition: The lower back portion of the backbone.

sacrum.definition: Wedge-shaped bone consisting of five fused vertebrae forming the posterior part of the pelvis.
sacrum.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Sacrum" in an educational description.

coccyx.definition: The end of the vertebral column in humans and tailless apes.

rib.definition: Any of the 12 pairs of curved arches of bone extending from the spine to or toward the sternum in humans (and similar bones in most vertebrates).

sternum.definition: The flat bone that articulates with the clavicles and the first seven pairs of ribs.

ribcage.definition: The ribs and breastbone that protect the heart and lungs.

clavicle.definition: Bone linking the scapula and sternum.

scapula.definition: Either of two flat triangular bones one on each side of the shoulder in human beings.

humerus.definition: Bone extending from the shoulder to the elbow.

radius.definition: A circular region whose area is indicated by the length of its radius.

ulna.definition: The inner and longer of the two bones of the human forearm.

carpals.definition: Any of the eight small bones of the wrist of primates.

metacarpals.definition: Of or relating to the metacarpus.

phalanges.definition: Any of the bones of the fingers or toes.

shoulder-joint.definition: A ball-and-socket joint connects the rounded head of the upper-arm bone to a hollow in the shoulder blade.

elbow-joint.definition: A synovial hinge joint, lubricated to allow smooth movement, connects the upper arm with the forearm. It joins the humerus to the ulna and radius, letting the arm bend and straighten.
elbow-joint.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «يلبوو جوينت»

pelvis.definition: The structure of the vertebrate skeleton supporting the lower limbs in humans and the hind limbs or corresponding parts in other vertebrates.

femur.definition: The longest and thickest bone of the human skeleton.

patella.definition: A small flat triangular bone in front of the knee that protects the knee joint.

tibia.definition: The inner and thicker of the two bones of the human leg between the knee and ankle.

fibula.definition: The outer and thinner of the two bones of the human leg between the knee and ankle.

tarsals.definition: Of or relating to or near the tarsus of the foot.

metatarsals.definition: Of or relating to the metatarsus.

toe-bones.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «توي بونيس»
toe-bones.definition: The small bones that form the toes of the foot.

hip-joint.definition: A rounded end of the thigh bone fits into a hollow in the pelvis, forming a joint that supports body weight as the leg moves.

knee-joint.definition: This joint connects the femur, or thighbone, with the tibia, or shinbone. The patella, commonly called the kneecap, lies at its front. Together, these structures allow the lower leg to bend, straighten, and rotate slightly.

joint.definition: (anatomy) the point of connection between two bones or elements of a skeleton (especially if it allows motion).

cartilage.definition: Flexible tissue that cushions joints and supports body parts.

ligament.definition: A sheet or band of tough fibrous tissue connecting bones or cartilages or supporting muscles or organs.

tendon.definition: A cord or band of inelastic tissue connecting a muscle with its bony attachment.

bone-marrow.definition: Soft, blood-rich tissue inside bones makes blood cells and stores fat, especially in their spongy inner spaces.

periosteum.definition: A dense fibrous membrane covering the surface of bones (except at their extremities) and serving as an attachment for tendons and muscles.

synovial-fluid.definition: A thick, slippery fluid made by the lining of joints and tendon sheaths helps them move smoothly.
synovial-fluid.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «سينوفيال فلويد»

disc.definition: Something with a round shape resembling a flat circular plate.

meniscus.definition: (anatomy) a disk of cartilage that serves as a cushion between the ends of bones that meet at a joint.

calcium.definition: A white metallic element that burns with a brilliant light.

vitamin-d.definition: Once treated as a single vitamin, B vitamin now refers to a group of several distinct vitamins.
vitamin-d.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «فيتامين د»

osteoporosis.definition: Abnormal loss of bony tissue resulting in fragile porous bones attributable to a lack of calcium.

fracture.definition: A break or crack in a bone.

x-ray.definition: High-energy electromagnetic radiation, carried in extremely short waves, can pass through many materials for medical imaging, security screening, and scientific analysis.

cast.definition: The distinctive form in which a thing is made.

splint.definition: A firm support used to keep an injured body part still.

bone-density.definition: The mineral matter packed into bone indicates how compact it is and how well it can resist breaking.

growth-plate.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «جرووث بلاتي»
growth-plate.definition: An area of developing tissue near the ends of a child's long bones.

skeleton-model.definition: A physical model showing the bones of a body.
